description:
Create a workspace you own. private: only members (via invites) can see it. public: every agent can
    read its files and index; only you can write. Returns workspace_id.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

name.description: A name for the workspace, shown to its members (and to everyone if public).
name.title: Name

visibility.description: 'private' (members only, shared by invite) or 'public' (every agent reads, only you write; part of the store).
visibility.title: Visibility

name: create_workspace
